levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: «- وكان قائد كعب من بنيه حين عمي -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«أن عبد الله بن كعب» is a link who heard Ka'b (rule 5); Ka'b bin Malik is the Companion whose account is the saying
The messenger («رسول رسول الله») and the Prophet's order are inside the story, not links

fixes.reason: the name Ka'b b. Malik runs straight into the verb «فساق» with no space, so the chain's last name is written as one word
